# The PBR, cel shading, and skybox shaders are owned and generated by the core fx2 module.
add_executable(GNsample-fx2-pbr simple-pbr.cpp)
target_link_libraries(GNsample-fx2-pbr GNcore)

add_executable(GNsample-fx2-cel-shading simple-cel-shading.cpp)
target_link_libraries(GNsample-fx2-cel-shading GNcore)
